description: Use when someone asks a common question on the Swiss FADP/nLPD/revDSG: whether it applies, differences with the GDPR, what changed in 2023, fines, personal and sensitive data, consent, the FDPIC, the Swiss representative, the record of processing, retention, security measures, privacy by design, a data protection advisor (DPO), privacy notices, DPIA, profiling, training, certification, transfers abroad and standard contractual clauses, processors and joint controllers, cloud services, AI tools, cookies, newsletters, video surveillance, employees, monitoring, applicants, photos, children, anonymous data, data breaches (also an e-mail sent to the wrong person), the rights of access, deletion and portability, an FDPIC investigation. Without an id the list; with an id the answer with the articles, the detail, the FADP/GDPR table where they differ, the templates that help and the link to the page.

id.description: The id of one question, from the list.

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.
